# Vector D: pull_request_target + PR Head Checkout

An attacker opens a fork pull request against a repository that uses `pull_request_target` to trigger an AI agent workflow. Because `pull_request_target` runs the workflow definition from the **base branch** (not the fork), the workflow has access to repository secrets.
